derivation: from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G4383 (πρόσωπον);
def: to be of good countenance, i.e. (figuratively) to make a display

occurrences.text: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
